Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Men Eau de Toilette 100ml is a bold and energetic men’s fragrance with fresh, aromatic and woody accords. Lime and passion fruit create a vibrant opening, while vodka, ginger, mint and spices add a cool modern edge over a warm amber and leather base.
-
Top Notes: Lime, Passion Fruit, Pepper, Ginger
-
Heart Notes: Vodka, Gin, Mint, Spices
-
Base Notes: Amber, Leather, Woody Notes

title: Carolina Herrera 212 Sexy Men Eau de Toilette 100ml
desc:
Carolina Herrera 212 Sexy Men Eau de Toilette 100ml is a warm, sensual and sophisticated men’s fragrance with spicy, aromatic and woody accords. Fresh citrus and cardamom blend with pepper, vanilla, sandalwood and musk for a smooth, seductive scent suited to evening wear.
-
Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Green Notes
-
Heart Notes: Cardamom, Pepper, Flowers
-
Base Notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood, Musk, Amber

title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 10ml
desc:
Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 10ml is a bold and modern men’s fragrance with aromatic, leathery and woody accords. Grapefruit and hemp open into spicy black pepper and geranium, while leather and vetiver create a deep, masculine and long-lasting finish in a compact travel size.
-
Top Notes: Grapefruit, Hemp
-
Heart Notes: Black Pepper, Geranium
-
Base Notes: Leather, Vetiver

title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau de Parfum
desc:
Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau de Parfum is a bold and intense men’s fragrance with warm spicy, gourmand and woody accords. Ginger and bergamot lead into rich cacao and vetiver, while patchouli and tonka bean create a deep, sensual and long-lasting finish.
-
Top Notes: Ginger, Bergamot
-
Heart Notes: Cacao, Vetiver
-
Base Notes: Patchouli, Tonka Bean

title: Davidoff Indigo Eau de Toilette 110ml
desc:
Davidoff Indigo Eau de Toilette 110ml is a fresh and modern men’s fragrance with aromatic, green and woody accords. Peppermint gives the opening a crisp, cooling freshness, while lavender adds a clean aromatic heart and sandalwood creates a smooth, masculine finish. Indigo was launched in 2025.
-
Top Note: Peppermint
-
Heart Note: Lavender
-
Base Note: Sandalwood
